content:
Elena Morales: Heads up — VireoHealth (acct: VIREO-221) reporting ACH microdeposit never posted. Customer tried to set up bank account, Stripe returned 'bank_account_validation_failed'. Invoice INV-4521 is due. Should we retry microdeposit or send wire instructions? Need sign-off for wire (they want it live ASAP).
Samir Patel: Got it. Can you paste the bank error / bank name? If it's a corporate account we usually need ACH verification + proof of account (voided check). Wire ok if finance approves. If we do wire, need routing + beneficiary details and an approval note.
Elena Morales: Bank: FirstFederal Bank (Routing 111000025). Customer says it's an LLC operating account. Stripe log shows 'bank_account_validation_failed — account type mismatch'.
Jae Kim: Looks like the error code we map to 14. Raw log snippet: ```json
{"ts":1765432099,"cust":"VIREO-221","err":"bank_account_validation_failed","code":14}
``` I recommend manual microdeposit retry after customer uploads voided check. Wire if they can’t provide docs quickly.
FinanceBot: AUTO: Invoice INV-4521 (12,450.00 USD) flagged for manual settlement. Hold reason: bank verification failure. Escalation ticket #PAY-7423.
Nora Li: I can approve a one-off wire for INV-4521 up to $12,500 if payments team confirms wire details and we get a signed waiver. Elena/Jae, confirm the wire payload and that the customer accepts fee responsibility.
Samir Patel: :thumbsup: I'll prepare the wire payload. Elena, send customer the secure instructions with this text and cc finance. Draft payload: ```
Please wire USD 12,450.00 to:
Beneficiary: Redwood Inference Inc.
Acct: 987654321
Routing: 111000025
Bank: FirstFederal Bank
Ref: INV-4521 / VIREO-221
```
Elena Morales: Sending now. Also asking them to upload a voided check; they said they can on Monday but need the app live today. I'll proceed with wire and attach signed waiver form as soon as I have it. Tagging @Nora Li for final ack.
Nora Li: Ack. Once waiver is attached and we have SWIFT/bank confirmation, finance will mark invoice as settled. Please route receipts to billing@redwood.ai. :white_check_mark: 
FinanceBot: NOTE: Please include payment method 'wire' in the invoice payment activity for audit. Created subtask PAY-7423-WIRE.
Samir Patel: Will post update after funds received. Moving this thread to resolved once payment hits. Thanks.
